description: This PHP source file defines the LDAPDao class, which is a Data Access Object responsible for interacting with LDAP-related entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching users, employees, LDAP providers, and sync status, mainly for LDAP authentication and synchronization purposes.

classes.name: LDAPDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for LDAP-related database operations, extending the BaseDao class.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersWhoHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Retrieves employee numbers associated with two or more users, likely to identify duplicate or linked accounts.

methods.name: getNonLocalUserByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a user with a given username who is not a local user, based on absence of a password, for LDAP authentication.

methods.name: getUserByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a user by username, excluding deleted users.

methods.name: getAuthProviderByUserUniqueId
methods.description: Retrieves LDAP authentication provider info based on a unique user ID.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Fetches employee details based on various LDAP search filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllLDAPAuthProviders
methods.description: Lists all LDAP authentication providers available in the system.

methods.name: saveLdapSyncStatus
methods.description: Persists LDAP sync status information to the database.

methods.name: getLastLDAPSyncStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent LDAP sync status record.
